info.name: Audio Cover Preview Formats
info.summary: Generate previews for more audio formats
info.description:
This app generates preview images for additional audio formats from the embedded album cover. These previois will be shown in the nextcloud list view to make browsing your music library easier. The geration is done with ffmpeg which is required for the app to work. Also imagemagick is recommended for best results and required for some optional settings.
The App has not been extensively tested. Usage is at your own risk. It is recommended to backup your DB and preview files before installing the app.
Currently the following formats are supported:
- M4A - OPUS - OGG - FLAC - MP3 (the nextcloud default provider seems to have issues with my files sometimes)
More information is avaliable on GitHub.
info.author: David Brauer
